title: helianthemum croceum var. stenophyllum
intro: Helianthemum croceum var. stenophyllum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the Rockrose family (Cistaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
